## Publisher checklist

- [ ] The release asset is built from the linked public source and attached to an immutable GitHub Release.
- [ ] `catalog.json` metadata, permissions, publisher key, version, and SHA-256 match the package.
- [ ] The repository documents building, privacy behavior, network use, and user-visible functionality.
- [ ] Requested permissions are the minimum required.
- [ ] The extension has a license and does not make misleading safety or learning claims.

## Maintainer review

- [ ] Publisher controls the source repository and signing key.
- [ ] Source/build provenance and package contents were reviewed.
- [ ] Permissions, data access, privacy, and pedagogical claims are proportionate and documented.
- [ ] Automated `validate` check passes.

Merging this pull request is the approval record. Catalog approval improves discoverability and supply-chain integrity; it is not a guarantee that extension code is harmless or effective.
